title: Nuxel App Registry
description: The single source of truth for application registration on Nuxel. Every software consumer — the D-Bus bridge (org.nuxel.Bridge), the permission portal (org.nuxel.Portal), the sandbox launcher (nuxel-sandbox), and the per-app nftables firewall (nftables.sh / configs/nftables) — resolves app identity, capabilities, network class and the deterministic cgroup name from this file. Nothing else may hardcode an app-id -> cgroup-name mapping.

schema_version.description: Registry schema revision. Bump on any breaking field change.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last regeneration (informational only).

path.description: Canonical on-device location of this registry.

cgroup_rule.description: The nftables socket-match pattern every app cgroup must satisfy.

apps.description: Every registered app. app_id is the primary key and MUST be unique.

app_id.description: Stable identifier used by the bridge/portal permission grants.

type.description: native = GTK4 C binary, pwa = WebKitGTK web app, system = system service, template = reusable profile.

executable.description: Absolute path to the binary the sandbox launcher exec()s (native only).

launch_args.description: Extra arguments passed to the launcher / executable.

cgroup_name.description: Deterministic cgroup name under /sys/fs/cgroup/nuxel/. MUST equal the deterministic mapping of app_id, otherwise the nftables 'app-*' socket match fails.

cgroup_classid.description: Legacy cgroup v1 net_cls.classid, used only on cgroup v1 hosts.

network_class.description: public = nftables ACCEPT + socket() syscalls. isolated = under firewall default-drop. unspec = inherit runtime flags.

default_capabilities.description: Capabilities enabled out of the box (no user prompt). Keep minimal.

capabilities.description: Requestable capabilities a user may grant via the portal.

data_dir.description: App-scoped writable directory granted rw by Landlock.

dbus_access.description: D-Bus bus names the app may talk to.

devices.description: Device nodes accessible to the app.

enabled.description: Set false to deregister a soft-removed app without deleting its entry.
